propositions: a failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) triggers delete_issue on a successfully-created Jira issue, destroying created work

the write-ahead binding persists the key before identity writes, but rollback deletes the issue without unbinding, leaving a keyed-pending entry pointing to a deleted key that strands the local ticket permanently
recover_pending's keyed branch exists to retro-attach labels and properties deterministically without search, making the rollback delete redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery

the field-not-on-screen error from Jira is misleading and conflates three distinct causes: missing screen configuration, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or malformed field values
rebar must declare labels as a required Create/Edit screen field rather than attempting createmeta pre-flight discovery or field validation
the BindingPersistError case (persist failure before write) creates an unmarked but undeleted issue that the inbound pass adopts as new remote work, which is preferable to deletion
